test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 20 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Arbaz and Aman can complete painting a building in 16 days and 12 days, respectively. If Arbaz starts the work and they work on alternate days, then the building painting will be completed in how many days?
solution:
**Given:**

The total work is 48 units (LCM of 16 and 12).

Arbaz can do 3 units of work per day (48/16) and Aman can do 4 units of work per day (48/12).

**To find:**

In how many days will Arbaz and Aman complete the work if they work alternately?
